findings.problem: Saved Voice state is under cleanup-owned REMOTE/saved. Failed restore only prints a warning, then stand-in out removes that backup; the remote guard removes it without restoration after disconnect.
findings.repair: Keep recovery data outside automatic cleanup until verified restoration, propagate failure, and make guard/disconnect recovery explicit; test failed restoration and guard expiry with saved data.

findings.problem: Pre-existing stand-up-nudge guard treats a failed skills list as absence, then cleanup unconditionally removes that name. A transient list failure can therefore remove a pre-existing owner skill.
findings.repair: Require a successful complete list before interpreting absence or arming unconditional removal; test nonzero list with no output before any mutation/playback.
